title: Multi-scale analysis for multilinear operators
summary: We develop a unified multi-scale framework for sparse domination of multilinear operators beyond the multilinear Calderón--Zygmund theory. More precisely, under mild hypotheses on a support condition, weak type and restricted strong type uniform bounds for finite partial sums, and single-scale improving and regularity estimates, we establish $(r_1, \ldots, r_m, s')$-sparse form bound for a family of localized $m$-linear operators uniformly over all finite partial sums.
